unknown_members_policy.description: How to handle unknown members in archive-style files. Valid values are 'abort', 'omit', or 'keep'.

lightweight.description: If true, uses lightweight cleaning mode which removes some but not all metadata to preserve file quality.

no_sandbox.description: If true, disables bubblewrap's sandboxing environment. Default is false (sandbox enabled).

inplace.description: If true, cleans files in place without creating a backup. Default is false (creates .cleaned backup).

verbose.description: If true, enables verbose status information during execution.

output_dir.description: The directory where cleaned files (with '.cleaned' suffix) are saved.

file_patterns.description: List of file patterns (glob style) to process. Empty list implies all files in context.
